definitions.gloss: to help each other, to help one another
definitions.explanation: To provide mutual assistance, with each party helping the other.

definitions.gloss: to cooperate, to support each other
definitions.explanation: To work together by providing mutual support.

notes:
{助|たす}け{合|あ}う is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to help each other.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧ (to help) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (each other) → to help each other

ASPECT (ている):
{助|たす}け{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing state of mutual help.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{互|たが}いに→互いに：07150_tagaini⟧{助|たす}け{合|あ}う (help each other mutually)
- ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦{時|とき}→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{助|たす}け{合|あ}う (help each other in times of trouble)
- ⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}い→助け合い：16991_tasukeai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧ (spirit of mutual help)

RELATED NOUN:
- ⟦{助|たす}け{合|あ}い→助け合い：16991_tasukeai⟧: mutual help, mutual aid

- ⟦{競|きそ}い{合|あ}う→競い合う：04656_kisoiau⟧: to compete with each other
- ⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}う→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧: to discuss with each other
